adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the code persists new attendees via `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)` before performing external side effects (`await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)`). There is no transaction or compensation logic; `updateCalendarAttendees` is not wrapped in a try/catch, so if it throws, the mutation fails but the DB write has already committed, leaving booking attendees updated while calendar updates/emails may not have occurred.
